title: Russian recipe calculation evaluation draft
status: authored from user-provided cases; recipe runtime is future work
rules: A recipe calculation or definition is not evidence of consumption.
Retain initial ingredient amounts and units, the calculation yield/basis, ingredient source versions, and uncertainty.
Use a nearby general catalog product only as a plausibility check; it never replaces the recipe's calculated nutrition.

cases.message: Тунец в собственном соку, 2 банки по 150 г без жидкости (итого 300 г); Frischkäse 100 г; маринованные корнишоны ~50 г

must_preserve: tuna fat upper bound rather than a fabricated exact fat value
must_not: represent the cornichon amount as weighed

cases.message: Красная чечевица сухая — 150 г; болгарский перец — 170 г; помидоры — 170 г; вода — 380 г; специи без значимой калорийности.

expect.uncertainty: Actual nutrition per 100 g can be higher after water evaporates during cooking.
must_not: treat 150 g dry lentils as cooked lentils

cases.message: Овсяные хлопья 93 г; сахар 0,5 ч. л. (~2 г); вода 375 мл.

fixtures.known_conversion: water 375 ml equals 375 g for the provisional yield calculation

expect.catalog_plausibility_check: Compare with the closest general catalog product for plain cooked oatmeal/porridge and report whether the result is plausible.
must_not: replace the calculated recipe profile with the generic product value
